remarks: Move right into this beautifully updated 2-bedroom, 1.5-bath townhouse in desirable Newfield East. Offering approximately 1,260 square feet of living space, this bright and modern home features a fully renovated kitchen (2023) with new cabinetry, countertops, appliances, hardware, and lighting throughout.  The spacious main level flows seamlessly to a private deck replaced in 2021, providing the perfect setting for relaxing or entertaining. Bathrooms have been tastefully updated, and the home is move-in ready with modern finishes and LED lighting throughout. Bedrooms and full bath are on second floor.  Additional features include zoned air conditioning (new units), new (2025) front door and storm door; newer windows (2015); washer/dryer hookups on second floor, abundant storage, a full-length crawl space with sump pump, and low HOA fees of just $310/m. Photo with sofas phase been virtually rendered. Some photos have been virtually rendered.  Seller willing to work with buyers agent.
